programme.title: Kiss Of The Damned
programme.desc: A blossoming romance between a vampire and a human is endangered by an unexpected visit.

programme.title: Honeymoon
programme.desc: A newlywed couple's idyllic country-lake honeymoon descends into chaos.

programme.title: Marrowbone
programme.desc: A ghostly presence and a lawyer come between four young siblings. They must stand together or be torn apart.

programme.title: Everybody Loves Sunshine
programme.desc: In Manchester's Pepperhill Estate, cousins and gang leaders Ray (Andrew Goth) and Terry (Goldie) have always relied on each other. Ray, tired of gang life and in love with Clare (Rachel Shelley), wants out. But Terry, obsessed with keeping Ray in the gang, won't let him leave. While they're in prison, the Chinese Triad kills a gang member. As revenge looms, aging gangster Bernie (David Bowie) struggles to maintain peace.

programme.title: Deliver Us From Evil
programme.desc: After a kidnapping, a secret-agent-turned-mercenary reemerges upon learning the crime hits close to home. However, when an infamous gangster learns just who has entered the country, he goes on a bloody rampage to thwart the rescue mission.

programme.title: The Sacrament
programme.desc: A mysterious rural utopia quickly becomes evident that this paradise may not be as it seems.

programme.title: Ip Man 2: Legend of the Grandmaster
programme.desc: International superstar Donnie Yen reprises his iconic role as the real-life kung fu grandmaster Ip Man, widely created as the man who brought Wing Chun kung fu to the world with the help of his star pupil- Bruce Lee. Master Ip, a new arrival in British-occupied Hong Kong, wants to open a martial arts academy to teach his unique Wing Chun style. A corrupt cabal of martial arts masters, led by Master Hung (Sammo Hung) refuses to allow him to teach in peace until he proves himself in a series of fights against the local master, which Ip does, in style. But even after earning the respect of the local masters, Ip’s troubles are far from over. Hong Kong under British rule is a new world of corruption and conflict between the Chinese locals and the British expats that run the city. When a Western-style boxer named “Twister” (Darren Shahlavi) comes to town to entertain the Brits, he insults Chinese martial arts in a horrifically violent way, and Ip is forced by honor to enter a brutal “King of the Ring” boxing match against Twister- and it’s East versus West in an amazing, knock-down drag-out fight to the finish.

programme.title: Ip Man: The Final Fight
programme.desc: Legendary Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man finds himself drawn into dangerous underworld of the Triads. In order to defend life and honor, he has no choice but to fight one last time.

programme.title: The Lingering
programme.desc: When Dawa was a child, he and his mother were tormented by a strange presence in their house causing them to spend a fearful night hiding in the basement. Years later, after his mother’s death, Dawa is forced to return, once again facing the presence that once tortured him as a child. Is it a ghost or is there something more earthly to explain the strange occurrences?

programme.title: Meek's Cutoff
programme.desc: Settlers traveling through the Oregon desert in 1845 find themselves stranded in harsh conditions.

programme.title: Let The Right One In
programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Better Watch Out
programme.desc: On a quiet suburban street, a babysitter must defend a twelve-year-old boy from intruders, only to discover it's far from a normal home invasion.

programme.title: Krampus: The Reckoning
programme.desc: Zoe, a strange child has a not so imaginary friend the Krampus who is the dark companion of St. Nicholas. This legendary creature has been unleashed upon a small town and begins seeking out all the naughty people to punish them at Christmas time.

programme.title: Mother Krampus 2: Slay Ride
programme.desc: It's Christmas time in Cleveland, Ohio, and four young women are on the verge of completing their mandatory thirty days of community service. With only one night to go, they are required to make a series of in-home visits to the older and less fortunate. Upon arriving at their final stop for the night, they are introduced to a pleasant older woman who graciously welcomes them into her home for the evening.

programme.title: Bloody New Year
programme.desc: Five shipwrecked English teenagers take refuge in an island hotel that is decorated for New Years. The problem is, it's early summer, and soon enough, even the walls themselves are striking out against them...

programme.title: False Flag
programme.desc: Sean, a sidelined CIA Officer, struggles with depression after his last Ukraine mission. Bored and yearning for action, he learns of a domestic op by Homeland Security that would put him undercover. But when he discovers it's a series of false flag attacks aimed at dismantling the US Constitution, he must act. After diplomacy fails, he resorts to sabotage and, ultimately, violence to stop it.

programme.title: Wind Walkers
programme.desc: With one of their own missing, a group of friends travel to the remote Florida everglades where they discover that an ancient, malevolent curse is tracking them.

programme.title: Open Windows
programme.desc: A jilted fan soon finds himself pulled into a deadly game of cat-and-mouse after he accepts the opportunity to spy on his favorite actress via his laptop.

programme.title: We Need to Talk About Kevin
programme.desc: Eva is mother to the evil Kevin. She contends with her clueless husband and her son's malevolent ways, in this chilling and unforgettable film.

programme.title: The Wailing
programme.desc: Soon after a stranger arrives in a little village, a mysterious sickness starts spreading. A policeman, drawn into the incident, is forced to solve the mystery in order to save his daughter.

programme.title: Becoming Evil: The Mafia - Vegas - The City the Mob Made - Las Vegas Before the Mob
programme.desc: Organized crime in America has a long and sordid history that can be traced back to street gangs of the 1800s. The violent and corruption escalated and captured the attention of the nation during the Prohibition Era when Lucky Luciano, John Dillinger, Baby Face Nelson, Bugsy Siegel and Al Capone became household names. The Mafia’s influence has infiltrated big business and politics while being a permanent area of focus for law enforcement and the media alike. This fascinating investigative documentary series explores the history of organized crime and the most notable players in evolving empire of evil.

programme.title: The Truth About Emanuel
programme.desc: A troubled young woman becomes obsessed with her mysterious new neighbor, who bears a striking resemblance to the girl's dead mother.

programme.title: Vanishing on 7th Street
programme.desc: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.

programme.title: Slay Belles
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve, three cosplaying women accidentally unleash Krampus and team up with Santa Claus to save the world!

programme.title: The Elf
programme.desc: Nick is haunted by night terrors stemming from a tragic murder he saw when he was young. After inheriting an old toy shop, he discovers a cursed elf doll sealed inside an ancient chest with a naughty list of his family’s names written on it. He soon discovers that the elf was an evil conduit meant to unleash a supernatural killing spree during the Christmas Holidays by whomever set it free.

programme.title: Infinite Santa 8000
programme.desc: A thousand years ago the world completely collapsed. War, famine, and greed killed off the human race. Not much remains except for the mutants, scum, and robo-people. Humanity is a long-lost notion. Everyone must kill to survive. Even Santa.

programme.title: Better Watch Out

programme.desc: Oskar, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Eli, a beautiful but peculiar girl.

programme.title: Terrifier

programme.title: Uncaged
programme.desc: After finding a gruesomely slaughtered family just outside Amsterdam, the police calls veterinarian Lizzy for help. She finds herself leading the city-wide hunt for a monstrous lion terrorizing the Dutch capital in this grisly adventure.

programme.title: Tangent Room
programme.desc: Trapped in a room with no escape, four brilliant minds race against time to prevent a cosmic collapse of the universe.

programme.title: Jonathan
programme.desc: Jonathan is an early riser who works at an architecture firm, whereas John is a night owl and a bit of a mess. The only problem is that they inhabit the same body, which works through careful planning until things start to fall apart.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Acclaimed filmmakers Moorhead and Benson return with this mind-bending thriller that follows two brothers who receive a cryptic video message inspiring them to revisit the UFO death cult they escaped a decade earlier.

programme.title: Alien Arrival
programme.desc: A tech is sprung from prison by a revolutionary leader who promises him an opportunity to save his father from a scheduled execution if he completes a data-stealing mission. But it goes awry, stranding him on a strange alien moon.

programme.title: Alien Reptilian Legacy
programme.desc: Researchers reveal the presence of a supreme interdimensional intelligence that has been manipulating mankind for centuries. Interviews with experiencers and alien abductees expose a sinister agenda behind the alien presence on Earth.

programme.title: Freaks
programme.desc: Kept locked inside the house by her father, 7-year-old Chloe lives in fear and fascination of the outside world, where Abnormals create a constant threat – or so she believes. When a mysterious stranger offers her a glimpse of what’s really happening outside, Chloe soon finds that while the truth isn’t so simple, the danger is very real.

programme.title: Assimilate (aka Replicate)
programme.desc: Best friends Zach (Joel Courtney, THE KISSING BOOTH), Randy (Calum Worthy), and Kayla (Andi Matichak, HALLOWEEN) discover that their neighbors are being killed and replaced by perfect copies of their victims. Their only chance to survive is to covertly record the invasion in a desperate attempt to warn the world.

programme.title: Cosmic Conspiracy
programme.desc: There is a conspiracy to rule the world, but the truth is far stranger than fiction. Reality isn't what it seems. With UFO sightings and Alien Abductions on the rise, now is the time to awaken, and realize the biggest conspiracy of them all.

programme.title: 2036 Origin Unknown
programme.desc: After a deadly crash, mission controller Mackenzie Wilson assists an artificial intelligence system, A.R.T.I., to uncover a mysterious object under the surface of Mars that could change the future of Earth.
Two men. Living on the exact opposite side of the world. When one sleeps, the other one is awake. But when they finally meet, a simple question arises: Who is the dream and who is the dreamer?

programme.desc: New York, NY and Provincetown, MA: Experience the formative moments of Tony's career as he revisits his first job, the culinary institute that taught him the basics, a normal workday at Les Halles Brasserie, and his mysterious mentor, Bigfoot.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Join Tony on his quest to characterize the perfect bar in New York City. Discover the importance of a maniacal bartender, the proper chemical makeup of drinks, the joys of seedy dive-bars, and the need for late-night snacks.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: St. Petersburg, Russia: Tony plays spy in Russia and sets off to locate the best blinis and borscht St. Petersburg has to offer.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Known as Brazil's capital of happiness, Salvador da Bahia offers fruitful local markets, and rich Bahian cuisine. Here, Tony takes part in a traditional local ceremony, and experiences the culinary talents of the famous Bahian artist of the kitchen - Chef Dada.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Portugal & Southwest France: Visiting his boss's family farm, Tony helps slaughter and feast on a pig the family has been fattening all year. Then, Tony heads to France to experience the rich delights of a foie gras farm.

programme.title: Anthony Bourdain A Cook's Tour
programme.desc: Tony returns to his beloved Hanoi, Vietnam to visit his friend, Linh, for the Vietnamese lunar New Year holiday of Tet. Together they enjoy the holiday and indulge in all the exotic delicacies Vietnamese culture offers.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: At one time, the henequen trade made Merida, the capital of the Yucatan, one of the richest cities in the world. Journey with Rick into the Merida market stalls for a fresh look at the blending of Mayan traditions with Spanish influences.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Rick takes us on a remarkable journey through Oaxaca City during the revered Dia de Los Muertos (Day of the Dead) holiday. Much preparation for the celebration takes place in October, and Rick gives us an insider's look at the fiesta.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: Chorizo is the "bacon of Mexico." At his neighborhood Mexican grocery, Rick finds fresh-made chorizo and reveals how it is made. At the Medellin Market in Mexico City, he introduces us to green chorizo, a popular 20th-century innovation.

programme.title: Mexico One Plate at a Time with Rick Bayless
programme.desc: We find Rick and his daughter, Lanie, at Mexico City's colorful Sonora Market, an emporium of medicinal herbs and the best place to buy cazuelas. They also check out El Guero, an institution in Mexico City popularly known as "Tacos Hola!"

programme.title: Backroads Europe
programme.desc: The Via Romana once formed part of an extensive ancient trade route that led from Rome to Germania, and from Geneve to Augst within the borders of Switzerland. 2,000 years ago, Julius Caesar's Gallic affairs pulled Switzerland into history's spotlight. Here, cultural traditions still burn bright.

programme.title: Backroads Europe
programme.desc: Italy's Via Cassia once led north from Rome to Florence, finally joining the Via Aurelia at Luna (now Luni). As you meander northward along the ancient route, each unique location you visit, and the interesting people you meet there, speak vividly to the region's steeped history and culture.

programme.title: Mythical Roads
programme.desc: Ethiopia and the Horn of Africa are unique lands of mystery, a region that has been witness to great explorations and shipwreck disasters. Even today, this part of the world fascinates us, since it is believed by many to be the birthplace of mankind.

programme.title: Christmas in Americas National Parks
programme.desc: It is Christmastime in America's national parks. Yosemite, Yellowstone, Grand Teton, and Grand Canyon National Parks each offers Christmas visitors their own unique versions of comfort, joy, and the warmth of vintage lodges during the holiday season in the form of festive activities and gatherings.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: Colleen's family explores the Luray Caverns, experiences the White Oak Lavender Farm, and goes horseback riding at Fort Valley Ranch. To top off their adventure, the girls have some wild fun at the Virginia Safari Park.

programme.title: Family Travel with Colleen Kelly
programme.desc: Grab your Stetson and cowboy boots, we are heading to Dallas. The annual Pumpkin Village is fun for all ages. Indulge in authentic Tex Mex cuisine, relish in a beautiful sunset from Reunion Tower, and have a blast at the State Fair.

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Why did the English choose Jamestown, Yorktown, and Williamsburg, Virginia as their early American settlements? Why did King William III and Queen Mary II establish a university here? What was life like for the early colonists here? What crazy concoctions are to be found in a colonial apothecary?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: Who is buried under Glasgow Cathedral, and why? Who is Saint Mungo, and why is he so big? Why does Glasgow City Chambers look like a palace? How did this seaport town become a center for Scottish Enlightenment? And how did Charles Rennie Macintosh's creativity leave a permanent mark on this city?

programme.title: Curious Traveler
programme.desc: You may not be able to live like a royal, but wouldn't it be nice to shop like one? Let's explore the curious world of Royal Warrants, a special designation given to only the best shops and services, literally fit for a king (or queen, or prince, or princess). Kind of like knighthood for a shop.

programme.desc: This alloy is made from Tin and Bismuth, contains no lead and melts at around 280 degrees Fahrenheit. I have used this alloy for years and it's really easy to melt in a typical pan and hot plate.

programme.title: Homemade Modern

programme.title: Homemade Modern

programme.title: Homemade Modern

programme.title: Homemade Modern
